limitations: No live HTTP requests: missing/blocked source targets are not measured production HTTP 404s.
External links, script-generated URLs, dynamic imports, conditional/auth redirects and platform routing need runtime verification.
Cookie headers, third-party cookies, consent, trackers injected by external scripts and complete network behaviour are unverified.
Shared-menu presence, viewport, title and alt checks do not establish mobile usability or accessibility compliance.
Support-number/companion checks use static HTML text only; runtime-injected footers may supply missing copy. Keyword heuristics cannot certify clinical safety.
Product wording is checked against provided v1.1 rules; no PDF byte replacement, original-artwork or physical-performance verification.
Inline claims have page-level line 1 where stripped visible text cannot be mapped reliably; evidence excerpts identify the text.
